message.reasoning: User asks in Chinese: "最新的電影上映有哪些？" meaning "What are the latest movie releases?" They want a list of recent movies. We can provide a list of recent releases. But we might need to check if we have up-to-date info. As ChatGPT, we can provide a general answer. No function needed.
